votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Mixed-Use (MU) Zoning Consolidation Zoning Text and Map Amendment (Petition No.: PLNPCM2024-00707).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposal to consolidate up to 27 existing commercial, form-based, and mixed-use zoning districts into six new mixed-use districts, and deferred action on adopting the ordinance.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing authorizing the parameters for Resolution 14 of 2025 - Issuance of Airport Revenue Bonds, Series 2025.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a parameters resolution authorizing the issuance and sale of up to $700 million in Airport Revenue Bonds, Series 2025, to finance capital improvements to the Salt Lake City International Airport.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 44 of 2025 – Alley Closure at Madsen Park (approximately 9 North Chicago Street).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted an ordinance to indefinitely close a portion of a City-owned alley at approximately 9 North Chicago Street to consolidate parcels making up Madsen Park and facilitate park improvements funded by the Parks, Trails, & Open Space GO Bond.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 45 of 2025 – Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 128 North N Street.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted an ordinance rezoning 128 North N Street from SR-1A to RMF-30 to enable development of three residential infill rental housing units behind the primary structure on the property.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 46 of 2025 – Text Amendment Replacing Public Hearing Requirements for Appeals and Variances with Public Meetings.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted an ordinance amending Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code to comply with HB368 passed by the Utah Legislature in 2025, which prohibits cities from holding public hearings for appeals of land use decisions and requests for variances.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (board appointments and reappointments of Disciplinary Appeals Hearing Officers: Bradley Jeppsen, Christine Hashimoto, Neal Geddes, Kirsten R. Allen, and Clinton Drake).
votes.description: The Council approved the Consent Agenda, which included three new appointments and two reappointments of Disciplinary Appeals Hearing Officers, each for terms ending July 1, 2027.
